database_name: ArtVision Miami Art Week Opportunities Database
description: Searchable database of free (or justified low-fee prestigious) opportunities to exhibit digital or physical art during Miami Art Week, with emphasis on Web3/crypto related organizations or curators. Includes entry to events. For ArtVision podcast. Search by keyword e.g. MIAMI.

opportunities.title: FRONTERA Open Call by One Love Art DAO
opportunities.organization: One Love Art DAO (Non-profit 501c3, Digital Art Gallery)
opportunities.event_dates: During Miami Art Week (Nov 30 - Dec 6, 2026), exhibited at Hotel Yve
opportunities.what_looking_for: Works that challenge understanding and shift perspectives. Digital or physical, minted or unminted on any chain/marketplace, global artists welcome.
opportunities.search_or_google: One Love Art DAO FRONTERA open call OR forms.gle/DjERA61QPdZEf19SA
opportunities.application_questions: Google Form (details not fully scraped, but visual-focused; artists submit work, likely name, contact, statement, portfolio link). Over 100 responses as of Nov 3.
opportunities.receipts_required: Artwork visuals/link (they collect from selected), bio or statement implied, portfolio or marketplace link encouraged.
opportunities.notes: Confirmed free, international OK, can be exhibited elsewhere. Gallery at Hotel Yve Downtown Miami. Encouraging community opportunity.

opportunities.title: Miami After Dark Projection Exhibition - Render Network
opportunities.organization: Render Network / Render Foundation (decentralized GPU rendering, crypto/tech)
opportunities.event_dates: December 2, 2026 - 50-foot projection at The National Hotel, Miami Beach
opportunities.what_looking_for: Original digital works themed Miami After Dark, up to 2 minutes, must be rendered on Render Network (credits covered for selected).
opportunities.search_or_google: Render Network Miami After Dark open call OR renderfoundation.typeform.com
opportunities.application_questions: 9 questions in Typeform (starts with full name; includes contact, work details, portfolio/resume/cover letter style, about 7 minutes).
opportunities.receipts_required: Digital artwork file or link (rendered on network), portfolio pieces or links, biography or statement, resume/cover letter possible.
opportunities.notes: High visibility large-scale projection during Art Week. Some sources note US artists only - verify. No fee, technical support via credits. Prestigious tech-art intersection.
opportunities.status: Open as of 2026-11-04 (conflicting earlier closed notes, but primary sources Nov 15)

usage: Search by keyword (e.g. MIAMI) and filter by status open and deadline not passed. Update daily by adding new entries and marking expired.
